WeeklyWarnings: Holding bar 1 is the entry bar. TIMEOUT uses global/symbol holding limits; incomplete windows remain OPEN.
Same-bar policy: STOP_FIRST; raw exit-candle excursions reported separately.
Alphabetical entry priority; intrabar exit proceeds fund orders from the next session. Entry equity uses known opens, never today's Close.
PF PnL uses realized gross closed-trade PnL; PF net is separate. Win rate uses net wins/(wins+losses), breakevens excluded. Price R excludes costs.

Split-aware per-share costs: quantity remains in the dataset share basis; execution-equivalent quantity = dataset quantity / factor on each execution date. Minimum/fixed fee and percentage slippage are unchanged. This does not undo dividend adjustments or model whole-share historical lots.
